title: Release, earnings and policy review contract
summary: Dated official reference set for per-game release and commercial review; dynamic prices and policy eligibility must be rechecked, with no frozen payout or ranking assumptions.
limitations: Account and audience eligibility are not verified by a local checklist.
No publication, subscription, purchase, payout, policy feature or production data operation performed.
Human enjoyment, fairness and artistic review remain independent gates.
Platform rules may change after this snapshot; refresh before each release.
